voiceNote: Voice: first person, plain, confident, few words. No em dashes unless unavoidable. Real numbers only. The work leads; the copy gets out of the way.

siteSettings.heroLine: I lead brand creative for consumer brands, from first brief to final asset: identity, campaigns, packaging, retail, and motion.

about.headline: Off the clock you can catch me directing photoshoots where the talent has four legs, drawing letterforms by hand, and starting more creative projects than I can finish.
about.bio:
I'm Nicole, a designer with nine years in consumer brands and a focus on health, wellness, and lifestyle.

I work across the full creative arc, from strategy to production to final asset. At Independent Pet Partners I'm the only designer in house, so I lead everything from 360 campaigns to the systems behind them: brand guidelines, a loyalty program, and a credentialing program that keeps 75 locations consistent.

The work I care about most sits between marketing and design: taking what a brand knows about its audience and turning it into creative that moves people.

experience.summary: Sole in-house designer for a multi-location pet wellness retailer. Brand creative end to end: campaigns, email, social, packaging, web, signage, merch.
Co-founded a podcast brand. Designed the identity, template system, and website. 40K+ streams.
Brand identities, social systems, and motion for startups including Loop, Straight Shot Post Production, and Neon Cheetah.
In-house across product and marketing: packaging, social, stop motion, advertising, new product development.

recognition: Graphis Design Award, Silver, Design Annual 2021: Roosevelt dog food packaging (Independent Pet Partners)
BFA Graphic Design, Maryland Institute College of Art (MICA)
House of GAI, AI Branding Masterclass (2026)

projects.title: Let's Talk, Peaches
projects.intro: I co-founded the podcast and designed all of it: the identity, the episode template system, and the website. The show grew past 40,000 streams.

projects.title: Independent Pet Partners
projects.intro: Independent Pet Partners is a multi-brand pet wellness retailer. As the only designer in house, I lead brand creative across campaigns, email, social, packaging, web, signage, and merch.

extraBlocks.heading: Ask Us Anything
extraBlocks.body: I art directed this 360° brand campaign from brief to production: built the mood boards, helped shape the shot list, and directed the video and photo teams on set. The campaign shipped a brand video in three cuts for Meta and Instagram, plus an in-store image library that replaced stock photography across every channel.

extraBlocks.heading: Systems, not one-offs
extraBlocks.body:
Beyond campaigns I build the systems that keep the brand consistent: company-wide guidelines, the loyalty program identity, a multi-level credentialing program, and the wireframes for a full website redesign.

The Roosevelt house brand I helped design won a Graphis Silver award (Design Annual 2021) for its packaging.

projects.title: Loop
projects.intro: Loop is an app for working through personal challenges over live audio. I built the brand identity for its social presence, then a template and motion system the team could run with.

projects.title: Neon Cheetah
projects.intro: Neon Cheetah is a fashion blog that helps readers find their inner cheetah. I designed an identity and website bold enough to keep up.

projects.title: Forward
projects.intro: Brand identity for Forward, a coaching practice: logo, palette, type system, and a set of certification badges.

projects.title: Ubbi
projects.intro: Ubbi is a baby and lifestyle brand. I worked across product and marketing: new product development, packaging, social, stop motion, and advertising.

projects.title: Motion
projects.intro: Motion work cut in After Effects: stop motion, logo animation, a lyric video, and quote animations.

projects.title: Custom Lettering
projects.intro: Hand lettering in every pen, brush, and style I can get my hands on.

projects.title: Get Your ____ Together
projects.intro: A 150 page, hand bound, participatory book. Readers flip, rip, spin, and write in it to uncover what's inside.

projects.title: Party Depot
projects.intro: A rebrand that kicks the cliché party store aesthetic: organized, bold, and modern.

projects.title: Cup Shop
projects.intro: Retail-ready coffee mugs, each for a different kind of coffee lover, with posters, a lookbook, and a website.

projects.title: Urban Outfitters
projects.intro: Product design for Urban Outfitters' fall 2018 season, in femme and bohemian directions.

projects.title: Cookie Dough Confections
projects.intro: A summer internship at an edible cookie dough shop in NYC. I designed holiday packaging, a partnership label, and retail materials.
